source.title: IMAP Trigger node bug

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body: ## Describe the problem/error/question I'm constantly getting an random "Failed publish" workflow. It's totally random and it's not clear why it happens. Sure it's related with the IMAP node. The trigger works 99% of the time and randomly the workflow fails to publish with any intervention in the workflow. Literally the solution stops working without any manual publishing or changes to the workflow. ## What is the error message (if any)? I don't have any error message besides this: ## Please share your workflow/screenshots/recording ``` (Select the nodes on your canvas and use the keyboard shortcuts CMD+C/CTRL+C and CMD+V/CTRL+V to copy and paste the workflow.) ⚠️ WARNING ⚠️ If you have sensitive data in your workflow (like API keys), please remove it before sharing. ``` { "nodes": [ { "parameters": { "downloadAttachments": true, "options": {} }, "type": "n8n-nodes-base.emailReadImap", "typeVersion": 2.1, "position": [ -400, 720 ], "id": "10f62c9c-a58a-45af-b006-6ee36c23650f", "name": "Email Trigger (IMAP)", "credentials": { "imap": { "id": "PUGsNRogYW6mpXx4", "name": "IMAP Email" } } } ], "connections": { "Email Trigger (IMAP)": { "main": [ [] ] } }, "pinData": {}, "meta": { "templateCredsSetupCompleted": true, "instanceId": "3ce6ff7b23c0c339d9e0e96c98b57179bbef8d60b0d0635395deeed55ff26179" } } ## Share the output returned by the last node Doesn't exist because the problem is with the trigger node. ## Debug info ### core - n8nVersion: 2.45.6 - platform: docker (self-hosted) - nodeJsVersion: 26.12.1 - nodeEnv: production - database: postgres - executionMode: regular - concurrency: -1 - license: enterprise (production) ### storage - success: all - error: all - progress: false - manual: true - binaryMode: filesystem ### pruning - enabled: true - maxAge: 336 hours - maxCount: 10000 executions ### client - userAgent: mozilla/5.0 (windows nt 10.0; win64; x64) applewebkit/537.36 (khtml, like gecko) chrome/155.0.0.0 safari/537.36 - isTouchDevice: false Generated at: 2026-10-30T08:10:04.807Z
